run_gradio_app: run the gradio app to launch the MapAnything 3D reconstruction demo with GPU support
run_model_inference: run the MapAnything model on uploaded images to predict depth maps, normals, and 3D points
handle_uploads: handle uploaded video or image files and extract frames into a target directory for processing
gradio_demo_reconstruction: perform metric 3D reconstruction from images and export the result as a GLB file
measure_distance: measure 3D distance between two clicked points on a depth map using predicted world points
